{{ModBox}}
'''Tether Grenades''' is an [[The Index|Index]] Mod for the {{Weapon|Penta}}, {{Weapon|Secura Penta}}, and {{Weapon|Carmine Penta}} that causes launched grenades to stick to level geometry and pull nearby enemies. Additionally, grenades will stop bouncing from enemies, and will instead pass straight through them. It also adds delayed self-detonation to grenades.

==Drop Locations==
{{DropLocations}}

==Notes==
*Can be installed on the {{Weapon|Secura Penta}} and {{Weapon|Carmine Penta}}.
*Tether Grenades do not make contact with enemy bodies, reducing contact damage to zero but gains infinite body punch-through.
*Tether Grenades stick to surfaces, making {{M|Adhesive Blast}} redundant if this mod is equipped.
*Increases in-air explosion damage by 1.2x, but deals normal damage if the granade lands and the tether activates.
**On {{Weapon|Secura Penta}}, the radial falloff is reduced to 50% from 60%.
*Grenades will '''not''' tether [[Capture]], [[Synthesis]] or [[Disruption|Demolyst]] Targets.
*Self-detonation occurs '''10''' seconds after landing.
**Grenades can still be manually detonated.
*Cannot be equipped at the same time as {{M|Napalm Grenades}}.

==Tips==
*Multiple grenades can be used to substitute for Warframe crowd control abilities when not enough energy is present to cast abilities.
*Grenades will explode on contact with water and [[Tar-Mutalist MOA]]'s tar puddles.
*Grenades still cause self-stagger with this mod equipped.
*Can be considered as an alternative to {{M|Firestorm}}, as it drags enemies that might be out of range into the blast zone.

==Bugs==
*If your Penta is silenced, this mod will cause it to act as though it didn't have the silenced property at all.
*{{M|Adhesive Blast}} can be equipped but has no effect. Tether grenades will always punch through bodies and stick to surfaces.
*Grenades will stick to ragdolled enemies, such as those under the effects of abilities like {{A|Spellbind}}, {{A|Bastille}} or {{A|Larva}}, or those launched by [[Melee#Slam_Attack|Slam Attacks]]. Once the enemy leaves the ragdoll state, the grenade will be detonated.
**Grenades will additionally stick to dead enemies, which can then be moved.
*Tether and additional grenade glow effects are not influenced by weapon's energy color.
*This mod reduces grenade flight speed. {{M|Terminal Velocity}} or a [[Riven Mods|Riven Mod]] that adds a bonus to flight speed can offset this.

{{Codex|Unload percussive machine gun fire, or strike a heavy chord with a single charge shot. This is Octavia's signature rifle.}}
The '''Tenora''' is {{WF|Octavia}}'s [[Signature Weapon|signature]] assault rifle, which features two different firing modes: a standard full-auto fire mode that increases fire rate and accuracy the longer it shoots, and an [[Alternate Fire]] mode that fires a single powerful, charged shot. Has a chance to instantly refill magazine after a [[Enemy Body Parts|headshot]] charged shot kill while being used by Octavia.

This weapon can be sold for {{Cc|7,500}}.

==Characteristics==

* This weapon deals primarily {{D|Puncture}} damage.
* Primary fire requires a spool-up of '''9''' shots before optimal fire rate is achieved.
** Fire rate starts at '''40%''' of the listed value, and increases by '''7.5%''' per shot.
** '''40''' shots are required before optimal accuracy is achieved.
* Alternative fire charges a single powerful shot with perfect accuracy.
** Innate 1 meter [[Punch Through]].
** Uses 10 ammo per shot.
** Charge is automatic and does not need to be held down.
*Increased [[accuracy]] the longer the weapon is fired.

{{Advantages|name=Tenora|class=Rifle|trigger=Auto-Spool|
* Innate punch through helps bypasses thin obstacles and bodies.
}}

{{Disadvantages|name=Tenora|class=Rifle|trigger=Auto-Spool|
* Spool-up creates a warm-up period of weakness for fire rate, making short engagements undesirable.
}}

{{WeaponComparison|Tenora Prime}}

==Acquisition==
The Tenora's blueprint can be [[research]]ed from the [[Research/Tenno Lab|Tenno Lab]] in the [[dojo]].

{{BuildAutomatic|type=Weapon}}

==Notes==
*As a [[Signature Weapon]], Tenora gains a bonus effect with {{WF|Octavia}} or {{WF|Octavia Prime}}, where [[Enemy Body Parts|headshot]] kills with the [[Alternate Fire]] have a '''20%''' chance to instantly refill magazine.
**The refilled ammo is automatically deducted from ammo reserves, and does '''not''' generate ammo.
**No weak spots other than actual heads will trigger this effect.
*Tenora's charge shot deals 24 damage for every 1 ammo consumed (a total of 240 damage with max consumption of 10 ammo) per shot. This is of equal ammo efficiency to its primary fire.
*{{M|Heavy Caliber}}'s accuracy penalty will be very apparent even at full spool.

==Trivia==
*''Tenora'' is the [[wikipedia:Catalan language|Catalan]] word for ''[[wikipedia:Tenor|Tenor]]'', one of the highest classical male singing voices.
**Tenora may also be a reference to a type of [[wikipedia:Catalan shawm|Catalan Shawm]], an oboe-like woodwind instrument typically used in [[wikipedia:Catalonia|Catalonia]].
*While there are other weapons with spool-up time, like the {{Weapon|Soma}} and {{Weapon|Gorgon}} series, its accuracy being increased the longer the trigger is held is currently unique to the Tenora in the primary category and shared only with {{Weapon|Aksomati Prime}}.

==Bugs==
*Spent ammo cartridges will always use the default color scheme of the weapon.
*Riven mods that increase recoil above 55% appear to drain 11 ammo instead of 10 on charged shots.

The following weapons now have ammo pickup overrides, meaning they gain less from picking up ammo. {{Codex|The expert engineers in Parvos Granum’s division have optimized the Ferrox’s lethal power.}}
The '''Tenet Ferrox''' is the [[Tenet]] variant of the {{Weapon|Ferrox}}, with improvements to its [[critical chance]], [[critical multiplier]], [[status chance]], [[fire rate]], and [[magazine size]], slightly larger explosion radius, has innate [[Punch Through]] , and max radial [[damage falloff]]. It's primary fire trigger can be held to continuously charge and fire consecutive shots, essentially functioning like a slow fire rate fully automatic heavy rifle.

==Characteristics==
*This weapon deals primarily {{D|Puncture}} damage on its primary fire and {{D|Impact}} damage on its alt-fire.
*Primary Fire charges and shoots thin beams.
**Holding the fire button after shooting will immediately charge up the next shot.
***After reloading, trigger must be released and pressed again to begin firing, however. 
**Beams are [[hitscan]] and do not have [[Projectile Speed|projectile travel time]], despite the animation.
**Shots explode in a '''4''' meter radius after reaching maximum punch through distance.
***Explosion does not need direct line of sight to deal damage and will penetrate walls.
***Can benefit from {{M|Cautious Shot}}.
**Vaporizes enemies on kill, making it good for [[stealth]] when silenced.
*[[Alternate Fire]] throws the Ferrox, creating a field where it lands that deals {{D|Electricity}} damage every '''2''' seconds and continuously pulls enemies within '''10''' meters toward itself. The field lasts for '''30''' seconds.
**Throwing the spear consumes no ammo. Afterwards, a reload cycle must complete before it can fire or be thrown again. Any existing terrain-embedded spears are removed. Those embedded in a unit's body are not.
**The spear is an arcing projectile that can land and embed in the terrain or a unit.
**[[Multishot]] has no effect on the number of spears thrown.
**[[Fire Rate]] affects the damage frequency, but not the pull speed.
**({{M|Primed Firestorm|Primed}}){{M|Firestorm}} has no effect on pull range.
**The field has a flat, unmoddable 50% status chance. It cannot deal critical hits nor headshots and is not affected by multishot. The damage frequency is affected by fire rate. It does not snapshot anything.
*Reloads '''33%''' of the magazine per second while deployed or [[holster]]ed.
*Adversary Weapon:
**Comes with an additional bonus {{D|Impact}}, {{D|Heat}}, {{D|Cold}}, {{D|Electricity}}, {{D|Toxin}}, {{D|Magnetic}}, or {{D|Radiation}} damage, which increases the listed base damage of the weapon by 25%-60%.
***[[Valence Fusion]] can optionally change the resulting output damage type, and can upgrade the bonus increase (up to 60%).
**[[Polarization|Polarizing]] the weapon increases its max [[rank]] by '''2''', capping at rank '''40''' after '''5''' polarizations, granting the weapon additional mod capacity.
**{{Resource|Elemental Vice}} can be applied to the weapon after it has reached rank 40, allowing the bonus damage type to be swapped freely.
**Unlike Tenet weapons directly acquired from Sisters, the listed [[Mastery Rank]] requirement '''is''' enforced.

{{Advantages|class=Speargun|
*Very ammo efficient.
}}

{{Disadvantages|class=Speargun|
*Primary Fire:
**Cannot fire with a partial charge.
**The weapon fires as soon as it has reached a full charge which can lead to premature firing.
**Explosion inflicts [[Stagger|self-stagger]].
**Explosion has a [[Enemy Body Parts|headshot]] multiplier of 1x and cannot trigger headshot conditions.
**Explosion has linear [[Damage Falloff]] from 100% to 70% from central impact.
}}

==Tips==
*The weapon's throw attack is especially excellent at fighting off waves of {{Faction|Corpus}} enemies, as its pulling field can also reliably apply a shield-debilitating {{D|Electricity}} (or {{D|Magnetic}}, if modded with {{M|Primed Cryo Rounds}}) proc per DoT tick.
*Its good automatic fire rate still makes the speargun good at crowd control. Its mass obliteration ability is particularly notable when given a fire rate boost with either {{M|Speed Trigger}} or Warframe abilities such as {{WF|Wisp}}'s Haste Mote from her {{A|Reservoirs}}.
*{{WF|Styanax}}'s passive - boosted weapon [[Critical Chance]] scaled by his shields and overshields - is doubled for Spearguns such as Tenet Ferrox.

==Trivia==
*The Tenet Ferrox is the first Tenet ranged weapon obtainable via purchase from Ergo Glast, as all other available Tenet weapons from the Perrin Sequence have up to this point been melee weapons.
*The Tenet Ferrox is the first charge trigger weapon that has a fully automatic firing function.

==Bugs==
*Tether mode will not count as weapon damage for Citrine's {{A|Prismatic Gem}}.
*Tethers are linked from the base of the shaft, resulting in significantly weaker pull than the base Ferrox due to more of the pull force being downward, when thrown on the ground.
*For enemies with both [[Shield]] and [[Armor]], or with [[Overguard]], the Attraction Field is completely disabled, including damage and traction effects.

{{Codex|Alternate fire on this reengineered Plinx fires a projectile that pulls enemies close and then explodes. Its cooldown increases after the explosion to accommodate battery power demands.}}
The '''Tenet Plinx''' is the [[Tenet]] variant of the {{Weapon|Plinx}}. In addition to improvements to its damage, [[critical chance]], and [[status chance]], it has gained an [[Alternate Fire]] that consumes the entire magazine to fire a projectile that pulls in enemies and explodes, dealing {{D|Radiation}} damage at the cost of longer recharge delay.

==Characteristics==
*This weapon deals primarily {{D|Puncture}} damage and has innate {{D|Heat}} damage on its primary fire, and {{D|Radiation}} damage on its [[Alternate Fire]].
*Alternate Fire charges up a shot in '''0.8''' seconds to discharge an explosive that embeds, {{D|Knockdown|knocks down}} and pulls in enemies within '''6''' meters before exploding after '''0.8''' seconds, dealing damage and {{D|Ragdoll|Ragdolling}} enemies.
**Explosion does not need direct line of sight to deal damage and will penetrate walls.
**Alternate Fire only consumes a '''full''' magazine, resulting in a 1-round magazine and must fully recharge for every shot.
**Damage is multiplied by magazine size. Damage bonus is multiplicative to other damage buffs.
**Reload delay of '''2 '''seconds after using the alternate fire.
**Alternate fire does not benefit from {{M|Synth Charge}}.
*Does not use ammo pickups; ammo regenerates over time.
**Has a '''0.8''' second delay after the weapon stops firing before regenerating ammo. Then, regenerates '''20''' ammo per second; takes '''0.5''' seconds to regenerate a fully depleted battery excluding the delay.
*Adversary Weapon:
**Comes with an additional bonus {{D|Impact}}, {{D|Heat}}, {{D|Cold}}, {{D|Electricity}}, {{D|Toxin}}, {{D|Magnetic}}, or {{D|Radiation}} damage, based on the Sister's [[Adversary System/Progenitor|progenitor Warframe]], which increases the listed base damage of the weapon by 25%-60%.
***[[Valence Fusion]] can optionally change the resulting output damage type, and can upgrade the bonus increase (up to 60%).
**[[Polarization|Polarizing]] the weapon increases its max [[rank]] by '''2''', capping at rank '''40''' after '''5''' polarizations, granting the weapon additional mod capacity.
**{{Resource|Elemental Vice}} can be applied to the weapon after it has reached rank 40, allowing the bonus damage type to be swapped freely.
**Listed [[Mastery Rank]] requirement is not enforced - the weapon may theoretically be obtained at any mastery rank by acquiring and vanquishing a Sister that has this weapon equipped.

==Notes==

*The pull (but not the ragdoll from the explosion) effect works with Trinity's Well of life-affected enemies.
*Alt-fire will only fire if the magazine is full. Attempting to alt fire with partially full magazine will result in nothing happening.
**Despite the damage values listed on the arsenal, the attack deals 100 {{D|Impact}} on contact and 100 {{D|Radiation}} on explosion, multiplied by the magazine capacity. This results in 10x and 2x higher damage than what is respectively listed at base.
**Despite the status chance value listed on the arsenal, the alt-fire AoE has '''50%''' status chance, not 20%.
**Alt-fire AoE has an unlisted embedded delay of 0.8 seconds.
***The explosion may trigger early if the slug itself kills the target, especially on headshots. Sometimes, only one of its [[multishot]] slugs will skip the delay, while all others explode on time.
**{{M|Fulmination}} ({{M|Primed Fulmination|Primed}}) does '''not''' affect the pull radius.
**Increasing [[Magazine Capacity]] (e.g. {{M|Slip Magazine}} ({{M|Primed Slip Magazine|Primed}}), {{M|Ice Storm}}, {{M|Tainted Clip}}, or {{M|Combo Fury}}) will increase the Alternate Fire's damage.
***Damage bonus is multiplicative to base damage bonuses such as {{M|Hornet Strike}}.
